items.Augmentation: Second: health and an empowered hit after each ability.
items.Basilisk: Third: haste and armor shred stacking with Make Way.

metaBuilds.holes: Slow first clears without a jungle item, so he falls behind tempo junglers.

metaBuilds.synergy: Overlord cleaves camps, Rapture adds attack speed and omnivamp for sustain, Aegis Of Agawar adds health and bigger armor boosts when he drops low.

items.Overlord: First: cleave clears and permanent health stacks.
items.Rapture: Second: attack speed and omnivamp for jungle sustain.
items.Aegis Of Agawar: Third: health and bigger armor boosts at low health.

metaBuilds.holes: Low burst, so gank targets walk away before he kills them.

metaBuilds.synergy: Manta Scythe clears camps fast, Sky Splitter and Tainted Rounds stack on-hit damage onto his Sacred Oath cleave.

items.Manta Scythe: First: fast clears and bonus damage on isolated targets.
items.Sky Splitter: Second: lifesteal and current-health damage on-hit.
items.Tainted Rounds: Third: healing cut and on-hit damage that grows on low targets.

metaBuilds.holes: No health or armor at all, so the frontliner role falls apart.

optimizer.synergy: Viper, Basilisk and Painweaver stack armor shred and penetration on top of Make Way, while Spear Of Desolation brings Stone Forged Soul back faster for objective fights.

items.Viper: First: attack speed and armor shred for clears and ganks.
items.Basilisk: Second: health, haste and more armor shred.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: penetration and ultimate haste for Stone Forged Soul.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: stacking penetration and move speed for chasing.
items.Augmentation: Fifth: health and an empowered hit after abilities.
items.Solaris: Last: crit chance and a healing empowered hit.

swaps.gain: Sim shows +48% more rotation damage from armor shred and bonus ability damage.
swaps.lose: Cleave clears and permanent health stacks from camps.

optimizer.holes: Almost no defense, so as a diving jungler he dies after his combo.

metaBuilds.synergy: Lightning Hawk, Plasma Blade and Dust Devil stack crit and attack speed, and Assault Mode's bonus hits can crit and pop Pulsefire for true damage.

items.Lightning Hawk: First: crit and attack speed with a slowing empowered shot.
items.Plasma Blade: Second: magical and physical power plus stacking crit chance.
items.Dust Devil: Third: attack speed and move speed for kiting in Assault Mode.

metaBuilds.holes: No healing cut or sustain, so dive teams catch him once Energy Shield is used.

metaBuilds.synergy: Plasma Blade adds magical power for his magic-damage basic attacks and crit, Lightning Hawk stacks crit, Imperator makes Assault Mode crits hit harder.

items.Plasma Blade: First: magical power and crit chance for his magic basic attacks.
items.Lightning Hawk: Second: crit, attack speed and a slowing empowered shot.
items.Imperator: Third: big power and harder crits.

metaBuilds.holes: All burst, no defense; one gap-closer ends his damage.

metaBuilds.synergy: Lightning Hawk crits, Scattershot sprays extra crit projectiles that help pop Pulsefire, Tainted Rounds cuts healing and finishes low targets.

items.Lightning Hawk: First: crit and attack speed for early trades.
items.Scattershot: Second: homing extra projectiles that crit and clear minions.
items.Tainted Rounds: Third: healing cut and on-hit damage on low targets.

metaBuilds.holes: No lifesteal, so lane poke and mana costs in Assault Mode leave him low.

optimizer.synergy: Viper and Deathstalker shred armor through his fast basic attacks, Manta Scythe adds penetration and lifesteal, then Vanquisher, Imperator and Plasma Blade build crit burst.

items.Viper: First: attack speed and armor shred boosting on-hit and ability damage.
items.Deathstalker: Second: more attack speed and stacking armor shred per hit.
items.Manta Scythe: Third: penetration, lifesteal and faster wave clear.
items.Vanquisher: Fourth: crit, penetration and an execute.
items.Imperator: Fifth: harder crits once crit chance is stacked.
items.Plasma Blade: Last: magical power and stacking crit chance.

swaps.gain: Sim shows +77% more rotation damage from armor shred and bonus on-hit damage.
swaps.lose: Early crit chance and the slowing empowered shot.

swaps.gain: Sim shows +21% more one-combo burst.
swaps.lose: Magical power and stacking crit chance early.

optimizer.holes: Viper and Deathstalker shred physical armor, but Pulsefire turns his basic attacks into magic damage, so the shred helps less than it looks.

metaBuilds.synergy: Double Pain applies on-hit effects twice, so Sky Splitter's current-health damage hits twice, Basilisk shreds armor, Rapture stacks Bloodlust bleeds faster with attack speed.

items.Sky Splitter: First: current-health on-hit damage that Double Pain applies twice.
items.Basilisk: Second: health, haste and armor shred.
items.Rapture: Third: attack speed and omnivamp to reach max Bloodlust stacks.

metaBuilds.holes: No armor, so ranged poke wears him down before he can Stampede in.

metaBuilds.synergy: Basilisk shreds armor and adds haste, Rapture stacks Bloodlust quickly, Draconum adds armor and boosts Double Pain's healing.

items.Basilisk: First: health, haste and armor shred.
items.Rapture: Second: attack speed and omnivamp for Bloodlust stacks.
items.Draconum: Third: armor and boosted healing for Double Pain sustain.

metaBuilds.holes: Low early damage, so a lane bully can push him off waves.

metaBuilds.synergy: Sky Splitter's on-hit damage doubles through Double Pain, Rapture and Onixian Quiver pile attack speed into Warlord's Challenge for Bloodlust stacking.

items.Sky Splitter: First: lifesteal and current-health on-hit damage.
items.Rapture: Second: attack speed, health and omnivamp.
items.Onixian Quiver: Third: attack speed, crit and lifesteal with damage reduction when low.

metaBuilds.holes: Onixian Quiver's extra projectiles are built for ranged heroes, so a melee Grux gets less from it.

optimizer.synergy: Viper's bonus on-hit damage doubles through Double Pain, Solaris heals off empowered hits, The Perforator and Penumbra speed Stampede and Smash 'n Grab while ignoring armor.

items.Viper: First: attack speed, armor shred and bonus on-hit damage for Double Pain.
items.Solaris: Second: crit and a healing empowered hit after each ability.
items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor for Stampede and Double Pain.
items.Augmentation: Fourth: health and an empowered hit after abilities.
items.Basilisk: Fifth: health, haste and more armor shred.
items.Penumbra: Last: cuts basic cooldowns so Smash 'n Grab returns faster.

swaps.gain: Sim shows +49% more one-combo burst from armor shred and bonus on-hit damage.
swaps.lose: Lifesteal and the current-health damage that shreds tanks.

swaps.gain: Sim shows +98% more rotation damage.
swaps.lose: Health and ability haste for the frontline role.

optimizer.holes: No armor or lifesteal for a frontline offlaner, so long fights drain him.

metaBuilds.synergy: Sky Splitter's current-health hit lands twice on every Double Pain, Tainted Blade cuts healing during Warlord's Challenge, and Rapture's attack speed stacks Bloodlust faster.

items.Sky Splitter: First: Double Pain applies its health-percent hit twice per swing.
items.Tainted Blade: Second: cuts enemy healing and makes them take more damage.
items.Rapture: Third: attack speed and health so Bloodlust stacks fast and Grux lasts.

metaBuilds.holes: Against a team that kites and peels, Grux never gets the long club fight this build needs.

metaBuilds.synergy: Double Pain hits twice, so Basilisk's armor shred stacks quickly and Sky Splitter plus Bloodlust bleed tear through bruisers; Rapture adds attack speed for Warlord's Challenge.

items.Sky Splitter: First: current-health damage, doubled by Double Pain's twin on-hits.
items.Basilisk: Second: fast armor shred, plus speed to stay on target after Stampede.
items.Rapture: Third: attack speed and health for long Warlord's Challenge brawls.

metaBuilds.holes: No healing cut, so heavy-sustain teams outlast Grux in the long brawl.

metaBuilds.synergy: Basilisk and Rapture keep Grux hitting through Warlord's Challenge, then Gaia Greaves adds armor and a stored bonus hit for the first swing after Stampede.

items.Basilisk: First: armor shred so clubs and Bloodlust hit harder, plus chase speed.
items.Rapture: Second: attack speed and health to stack Bloodlust and stay in fights.
items.Gaia Greaves: Third: armor versus physical teams and a charged hit on arrival.

metaBuilds.holes: Gaia Greaves loses its stacks while slowed and does nothing against magic damage.

optimizer.synergy: Viper boosts on-hit and ability damage, which Double Pain applies twice, then armor-ignoring items and Penumbra's cooldown cuts keep Stampede and Smash 'n Grab cycling.

items.Viper: First: armor shred plus extra on-hit and ability damage for Double Pain.
items.Solaris: Second: an empowered hit that heals Grux between ability casts.
items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor so Stampede and Smash 'n Grab hurt tanks.
items.Augmentation: Fourth: another empowered hit, plus health and attack speed.
items.Basilisk: Fifth: more armor shred and chase speed for long fights.
items.Penumbra: Last: cuts non-ultimate cooldowns so Stampede and Smash 'n Grab return sooner.

swaps.gain: Armor shred and extra on-hit and ability damage that also boosts Stampede and Smash 'n Grab.
swaps.lose: Sky Splitter's lifesteal and current-health hits that melt tanks early in a fight.

optimizer.holes: Little armor until late, so a Grux who dives first can die before the shred pays off.

metaBuilds.synergy: Combustion's area blast and Wraith Leggings' ability boost stack on your ultimate and Land Mine, then Noxia rewards following one ability with another, like Make It Rain.

items.Combustion: First: area burst that pairs with Cluster Grenades for wave clear.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: more ability damage and magic armor ignore on every missile.
items.Noxia: Third: mark with one ability, then hit with another for health-percent damage.

metaBuilds.holes: All damage, no defense: a diver who reaches Howitzer before Land Mine is ready kills him.

metaBuilds.synergy: The same Combustion and Wraith Leggings burst, then Tainted Scepter cuts healing on every Cluster Grenade hit and adds bonus damage per ability hit.

items.Combustion: First: area burst to clear waves and punish grouped enemies.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: boosts every ability hit, including Make It Rain's missiles.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: healing cut on ability hits, plus a little health.

metaBuilds.holes: The health is small; against teams with little healing, the third slot's healing cut does little.

metaBuilds.synergy: Overseer heals Howitzer off ability damage to heroes, so landing Make It Rain and Land Mine in fights refills health after the Combustion and Wraith Leggings burst.

items.Combustion: First: area burst for wave clear and grouped targets.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: raw ability damage and magic armor ignore.
items.Overseer: Third: more damage and healing back from every hero hit.

metaBuilds.holes: The healing only comes from hitting heroes; a mobile team that dodges Make It Rain and Land Mine starves Overseer.

optimizer.synergy: Oathkeeper empowers the Cannon shot after each ability, lining up with Armed Salvo's bonus shot, while Oblivion Crown and Caustica scale every missile late.

items.Oathkeeper: First: empowered Cannon shot after abilities, alongside Armed Salvo.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Second: power and health, plus extra ability damage on monsters.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: ability damage boost for Make It Rain and your ultimate.
items.Oblivion Crown: Fourth: multiplies all power for late-game missiles.
items.Caustica: Fifth: ignores magic armor once enemies build defense.
items.Combustion: Last: area blast for grouped teamfights.

optimizer.holes: Combustion comes last, so Howitzer gives up the early wave clear and burst that rushing it gives.

metaBuilds.synergy: Orb Of Growth scales as Iggy levels, while Entropy's per-hit bonus and Megacosm's health-percent burn fire constantly off Flame Turret fireballs and Molotov fire.

items.Orb Of Growth: First: health and power that evolve as Iggy farms lane.
items.Entropy: Second: bonus damage on turret fireballs and fire ticks.
items.Megacosm: Third: health-percent burn that turrets keep refreshing on tanks.

metaBuilds.holes: Orb Of Growth is slow to pay off; if Iggy falls behind in lane the whole build stalls.

metaBuilds.synergy: Turrets and Oil Spill keep enemies taking constant hits, so Megacosm's burn and Tainted Scepter's healing cut stay applied for the whole fight.

items.Orb Of Growth: First: health, mana and power that evolve with experience.
items.Megacosm: Second: a burn that every turret shot refreshes.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: healing cut on all ability hits and bonus damage per hit.

metaBuilds.holes: Light on burst; squishy targets walk out of turret range before the damage adds up.

metaBuilds.synergy: Built for long fights: turret fireballs keep Megacosm burning, Entropy adds per-hit damage, and Tainted Scepter stops bruisers healing through the fire.

items.Megacosm: First: tank-shredding burn that turrets refresh constantly.
items.Entropy: Second: extra damage on every fire tick and fireball.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: cuts healing so bruisers can't outlast Ignite and Inferno.

metaBuilds.holes: No evolving item, so this build gives up Orb Of Growth's late upgrade.

optimizer.synergy: Spectral Schematics adds current-health damage to ability hits, Soulbinder rewards poking from far away with Molotov, and Oblivion Crown multiplies power for Inferno.

items.Spectral Schematics: First: current-health bonus damage that hits hardest at fight start.
items.Soulbinder: Second: bonus damage when poking from long range with Molotov.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: boosts every ability hit, including Inferno.
items.Oblivion Crown: Fourth: multiplies all power for late fights.
items.Oathkeeper: Fifth: empowered Spew after abilities for extra damage.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Last: power and health, plus more ability damage on monsters.

swaps.gain: Current-health burst on Molotov and Oil Spill from the very first item.
swaps.lose: Orb Of Growth's health, mana and level-based upgrade.

swaps.gain: Bigger opening hits on Molotov and Inferno against healthy targets.
swaps.lose: Megacosm's burn that turrets keep refreshing on tanky targets.

optimizer.holes: Little health beyond Spectral Schematics until Spirit Of Amir; a diver who reaches Iggy simply ignores the turrets.

metaBuilds.synergy: In the offlane Iggy plants turrets to zone; Orb Of Growth adds health, while Entropy and Megacosm add damage to each fireball and fire tick.

items.Orb Of Growth: First: health for the long solo lane, evolving as Iggy levels.
items.Entropy: Second: extra damage on each turret shot.
items.Megacosm: Third: burn that lets turrets chew through bruiser offlaners.

metaBuilds.holes: Into a hard-diving melee offlaner, turrets die fast and the build has little defense.

metaBuilds.synergy: Orb Of Growth and Megacosm add health, and Tainted Scepter cuts healing on bruisers trying to sustain through Oil Spill and Molotov fire.

items.Orb Of Growth: First: health and growth for a safer offlane.
items.Megacosm: Second: health plus a burn that turrets refresh.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: healing cut versus sustain bruisers.

metaBuilds.holes: Still a backline caster; the extra health doesn't let Iggy stand in front of a fight.

metaBuilds.synergy: Entropy first sharpens turret trades in lane, Megacosm then melts tanky offlaners, and Tainted Scepter shuts down healing in long fights.

items.Entropy: First: per-hit damage boost for turret-heavy lane trades.
items.Megacosm: Second: health-percent burn against tanky offlaners.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: healing cut on every fire tick.

metaBuilds.holes: Very few games behind it; treat it as an option, not a proven path.

optimizer.synergy: Spew redirects turrets onto Iggy's target, so Orion's attack speed and stacking damage boost let Iggy and the turrets focus one hero together.

items.Orion: First: attack speed and rising damage while Spew guides turrets.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: more damage on Molotov, Oil Spill and Inferno.
items.Oathkeeper: Third: empowered Spew after each ability cast.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: health and power for a safer lane.
items.Oblivion Crown: Fifth: big power multiplier for late fights.
items.Soulbinder: Last: bonus damage when poking from far range.

swaps.gain: Attack speed so Spew redirects turrets more often, plus a growing damage boost.
swaps.lose: Orb Of Growth's health and level-based upgrade for a long lane.

swaps.gain: Attack speed and a stacking damage boost on the focused target.
swaps.lose: Entropy's flat bonus on every fireball and fire tick.

optimizer.holes: Spew-focused play means standing in the offlaner's reach, and this build has little health for that trade.

metaBuilds.synergy: Narcosis holds a target still, so Combustion's blast, Wraith Leggings' boost and Noxia's marked follow-up all land when Brine pops a bubble on them.

items.Combustion: First: area burst that hits everyone near a popped bubble.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: boosts Brine, Narcosis and Genesis damage.
items.Noxia: Third: mark with Narcosis, then Brine triggers health-percent damage.

metaBuilds.holes: As carry, this trades steady attack damage for burst, and its field results trail the other builds.

metaBuilds.synergy: Prophecy adds on-hit damage and attack speed to Fathom, which pops bubbles and, with a Harbinger Eternal, shortens Brine's cooldown between Combustion and Noxia bursts.

items.Combustion: First: area burst for wave clear and bubble pops.
items.Prophecy: Second: on-hit damage and attack speed for Fathom between casts.
items.Noxia: Third: a marked target takes extra damage from the next ability.

metaBuilds.holes: No real defense; Ikra still dies fast to divers.

metaBuilds.synergy: Overseer heals Ikra off ability hits on heroes, so popping an amplified bubble with Brine both bursts the target and refills health.

items.Combustion: First: area burst for grouped targets.
items.Overseer: Second: more damage and healing from hero hits.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: ability damage boost and magic armor ignore.

metaBuilds.holes: The healing depends on landing Narcosis and bubbles; missed skill shots leave Ikra empty.

optimizer.synergy: Spectral Schematics adds current-health damage to the opening Brine, Oathkeeper empowers Fathom after casts, and Magnify shreds magic armor so Genesis finishes the fight.

items.Spectral Schematics: First: current-health bonus on the first Brine or bubble pop.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: boost on every ability hit.
items.Oathkeeper: Third: empowered Fathom after each cast, ready for bubble pops.
items.Magnify: Fourth: magic armor shred and some sustain.
items.Oblivion Crown: Fifth: power multiplier for late Genesis casts.
items.Combustion: Last: area blast for teamfights.

swaps.gain: Bigger opening hits from Brine and Narcosis on healthy targets.
swaps.lose: Combustion's area blast that hits grouped enemies around a bubble.

optimizer.holes: Mostly damage; a dive onto Ikra before Narcosis lands ends the fight.

metaBuilds.synergy: In mid, Hydroclasm bubbles hold the wave and enemies, then Combustion, Wraith Leggings and Noxia make the Narcosis into Brine combo a kill threat.

items.Combustion: First: wave clear when Brine pops a bubble on minions.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: ability damage for every Brine and Genesis cast.
items.Noxia: Third: Narcosis marks; Brine or Genesis triggers the bonus damage.

metaBuilds.holes: Against mobile mids the Narcosis setup misses often, and the burst never starts.

metaBuilds.synergy: Prophecy lets Fathom poke harder in lane and, with a Harbinger Eternal, keeps Brine cycling, while Combustion and Noxia stay the burst.

items.Combustion: First: wave clear and area burst.
items.Prophecy: Second: on-hit damage and attack speed for Fathom lane poke.
items.Noxia: Third: bonus health-percent damage after a marked hit.

metaBuilds.holes: Prophecy only pays if Ikra attacks a lot; a poke-only mid wastes it.

metaBuilds.synergy: Overseer turns Narcosis and amplified bubble hits into healing, letting Ikra stay in mid after trades instead of backing.

items.Combustion: First: wave clear and area burst.
items.Overseer: Second: damage boost and healing from hero hits.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: ability boost and magic armor ignore, arriving later.

metaBuilds.holes: Delaying Wraith Leggings makes the second-item burst weaker against magic-armor mids.

optimizer.synergy: Spectral Schematics front-loads Brine damage, Oathkeeper empowers Fathom after casts, and Magnify cuts magic armor before Oblivion Crown scales Genesis.

items.Spectral Schematics: First: big opening hit on full-health mids.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: ability damage boost on every cast.
items.Oathkeeper: Third: empowered Fathom after abilities for lane poke.
items.Magnify: Fourth: shreds magic armor and adds sustain.
items.Oblivion Crown: Fifth: multiplies power for late burst.
items.Combustion: Last: area blast, bought late here.

swaps.gain: Harder first hit on healthy targets with Brine and Narcosis.
swaps.lose: Combustion's area blast comes late, so wave clear in mid is slower.

optimizer.holes: Combustion comes last, so mid wave clear is slower than in builds that buy it first.

metaBuilds.synergy: Malady and Vanquisher pile damage onto Guillotine's missing-health scaling and Death Mark's true damage, then Spear Of Desolation brings Guillotine back faster.

items.Malady: First: armor ignore plus a burst that resets on takedowns.
items.Vanquisher: Second: executes low targets after Guillotine.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: faster Guillotine and a damage boost after hitting.

metaBuilds.holes: If the first target survives Shadow Dance and Guillotine, Kallari has no defense to stay in.

metaBuilds.synergy: The Perforator ignores armor, so Crippling Dagger, Shadow Dance and Guillotine still delete targets who build defense against Kallari.

items.Malady: First: armor ignore and takedown-reset burst.
items.Vanquisher: Second: execute to finish Guillotine targets.
items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor so the burst holds up late.

metaBuilds.holes: Pure burst; poor against grouped teams where Kallari can't isolate one target.

metaBuilds.synergy: Tainted Trident cuts healing, so Death Mark's detonation and Guillotine finish sustain heroes instead of them healing out.

items.Malady: First: burst with a takedown reset.
items.Vanquisher: Second: execute after the missing-health Guillotine.
items.Tainted Trident: Third: healing cut plus armor ignore.

metaBuilds.holes: The healing cut only matters versus sustain; otherwise The Perforator hits harder.

optimizer.synergy: Viper shreds armor and boosts Crippling Dagger and Shadow Dance damage, Spear Of Desolation shortens Guillotine, and empowered-hit items punish targets after each cast.

items.Viper: First: armor shred and more ability and on-hit damage.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Second: faster Guillotine and a bonus damage window.
items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor for burst into tanks.
items.Augmentation: Fourth: empowered hit plus health for skirmishes.
items.Solaris: Fifth: empowered hit that heals Kallari.
items.Painweaver: Last: stacking armor ignore and speed while chasing.

swaps.gain: Steady armor shred and more damage on Crippling Dagger and Shadow Dance.
swaps.lose: Malady's takedown-reset burst that chains kills in fights.

optimizer.holes: No execute item, so low targets can slip away where Vanquisher would finish them.

metaBuilds.synergy: Overlord's cleave spreads Unleash's rapid attacks, Basilisk shreds armor while Ambush slows, and Rapture adds attack speed to build Rage faster.

items.Overlord: First: cleave for fast clears and health that grows from camps.
items.Basilisk: Second: armor shred and speed to stick after Ambush.
items.Rapture: Third: attack speed and health to keep Rage high.

metaBuilds.holes: Thin on burst; against squishy teams Khaimera hits often but doesn't kill.

metaBuilds.synergy: Claw Of Hermes' magical power adds extra Unleash attacks, Ashbringer's on-hit cooldown cuts bring Ambush and Invigorate back sooner, and Draconum heals.

items.Ashbringer: First: on-hit cooldown cuts bring Ambush and Invigorate back sooner.
items.Claw Of Hermes: Second: magical power adds Unleash attacks and drains mana.
items.Draconum: Third: armor and healing to survive long brawls.

metaBuilds.holes: Mixed stats; if Khaimera falls behind, neither damage type is strong enough.

metaBuilds.synergy: Sky Splitter's current-health hits ride Unleash's fast attacks, Overlord cleaves them, and Basilisk shreds armor before Cull lands.

items.Sky Splitter: Second: current-health damage on each Unleash hit, plus lifesteal.
items.Basilisk: Third: armor shred before Cull's stun.

metaBuilds.holes: Unleash applies on-hit effects at reduced strength, so Sky Splitter gives less than expected.

optimizer.synergy: Viper and Deathstalker shred armor fast during Unleash's rapid attacks, Spear Of Desolation shortens Cull, and The Perforator lets Cull ignore part of the target's armor.

items.Viper: First: armor shred and more on-hit and ability damage.
items.Deathstalker: Second: more attack speed and armor shred during Unleash.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: faster Cull and a damage window.
items.The Perforator: Fourth: armor ignore for Cull and Ambush.
items.Solaris: Fifth: empowered hit that heals Khaimera.
items.Augmentation: Last: empowered hit plus health.

swaps.gain: Armor shred and extra damage on Ambush and Cull.
swaps.lose: Overlord's cleave clear speed and the health it grows from camps.

optimizer.holes: Little defense; Khaimera must lean on Invigorate and Rage regen to survive.

metaBuilds.synergy: Overlord's cleave lets Khaimera trade on the wave in the offlane, Basilisk shreds the laner's armor, and Rapture keeps Rage climbing.

items.Overlord: First: cleave on waves and health stacks from heroes.
items.Basilisk: Second: armor shred during Unleash trades.
items.Rapture: Third: attack speed and healing for long fights.

metaBuilds.holes: Few games behind it; kiting lanes keep Khaimera off the target.

metaBuilds.synergy: All magical power and attack speed: each chunk of magical power adds Unleash attacks, and Prophecy's on-hit damage rides every extra swing.

items.Claw Of Hermes: First: magical power for extra Unleash attacks, plus mana drain.
items.Prophecy: Second: on-hit damage and attack speed on every swing.
items.Orion: Third: attack speed from haste and a growing damage boost.

metaBuilds.holes: The weakest results of these builds and little defense; Khaimera melts before the extra attacks matter.

metaBuilds.synergy: Void Helm boosts all healing, stacking with Invigorate and Sky Splitter's lifesteal, while Claw Of Hermes adds Unleash attacks.

items.Claw Of Hermes: First: extra Unleash attacks and mana drain.
items.Sky Splitter: Second: current-health hits with lifesteal.
items.Void Helm: Third: magic armor and stronger Invigorate and lifesteal healing.

metaBuilds.holes: Void Helm only covers magic damage; physical lanes still bully Khaimera.

optimizer.synergy: Viper shreds armor during Unleash, Spear Of Desolation brings Cull back faster, and The Perforator and Painweaver let Ambush and Cull hurt tanky offlaners.

items.Viper: First: armor shred and more on-hit and ability damage.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Second: faster Cull and a damage window.
items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor for Ambush and Cull.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: stacking armor ignore and speed in chases.
items.Augmentation: Fifth: empowered hit plus health.
items.Solaris: Last: empowered hit that heals.

swaps.gain: Armor shred and extra damage on Ambush and Cull.
swaps.lose: Overlord's wave cleave and the health it stacks from heroes.

swaps.gain: Armor shred and stronger on-hit and ability damage.
swaps.lose: Claw Of Hermes' magical power that adds extra Unleash attacks.

optimizer.holes: No sustain item until Solaris, so early offlane trades can bleed Khaimera out.

metaBuilds.synergy: Solaris empowers Kira's next hit, Ashbringer's hits (crits most) cut Shadow Glide and Dusk cooldowns, and Imperator makes crits on Mercy and Purge hit harder.

items.Solaris: First: empowered crit hit and healing between casts.
items.Ashbringer: Second: on-hit cooldown cuts for Shadow Glide and Dusk.
items.Imperator: Third: bigger crits on basics, Mercy and Purge.

metaBuilds.holes: No armor ignore, so against stacked armor Kira's crits fall flat late.

metaBuilds.synergy: Ruination's bleed drains mana as true damage and refreshes on ability hits like Dusk, adding burst on top of Imperator crits.

items.Solaris: First: empowered hit and healing.
items.Ruination: Second: big power and a true-damage bleed that Dusk refreshes.
